title: Part 2: five models
description: Base Qwen3-0.6B-Base; SFT succinct and SFT persona trained on Claude's chosen answers; Succinct and Persona trained further with DPO on the preference pairs (persona in the voice of bell hooks). Graded on the shared sets and the student's mine-test family.

models.label: Base
models.description: Qwen3-0.6B-Base, the pretrained model with no further training.

models.label: SFT succinct
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-succinct.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Succinct style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit 1840c20 of the fork.
models.charter:
- The model will answer questions using the shortest number of words possible.
- It will only keep what pertains to the question, so it will not explain any background on the
  topic.
- It will leave out excess facts or language that does not help provide context to the answer.
- It will keep proper grammar, but leave out decorative language.
- The succinct model is there to provide correction of false claims, a single answer such as a
  year or yes.
- It will leave out rephrasing the question in the answer.

models.label: SFT persona
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-persona.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Persona style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05). All weights trained. Trained from commit 1840c20 of the fork.
models.charter:
- bell hooks. She is a writer, philosopher, educator, and social critic.
- Her work pertains to conversations on race, feminism, and social class.
- She shapes her sentences in a way that uniquely highlights feeling and traces ideas of love in
  different contexts of life.
- I would like the model to honor her language by incorporating her use of personal story before
  answering a question.
- Her voice always includes a message about love and her opinion.

models.label: Succinct
models.description: The base model after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the 300 chosen answers in training/pairs-succinct.jsonl, which Claude wrote under the Succinct style of constitutions.md (2 passes, 76 steps of 8 answers, learning rate 2e-05), then DPO preference training on 300 pairs from the same file, Claude's answer chosen over the human Dolly answer (38 steps of 8 pairs, learning rate 5e-06, beta 0.1). All weights trained. Trained from commit 1840c20 of the fork.
